description: This file defines data models for OpenAPI components using Pydantic, including schemas for API documentation such as Info, Server, Contact, License, and various OpenAPI objects like Paths, Operations, Responses, and Security Schemes.

classes.name: BaseModelWithConfig
classes.description: A Pydantic BaseModel subclass with custom configuration allowing extra fields.

classes.name: Contact
classes.description: Model representing contact information for API info.

classes.name: License
classes.description: Model representing license information for API info.

classes.name: Info
classes.description: Model representing the API information section.

classes.name: ServerVariable
classes.description: Model for server variable with enum options, default value, and description.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Model representing server details including URL, description, and variables.

classes.name: XML
classes.description: Model for XML object in OpenAPI.

classes.name: Schema
classes.description: Model representing JSON Schema with OpenAPI extensions.

classes.name: Example
classes.description: TypedDict for example objects in OpenAPI.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Model for link object in responses.

classes.name: PathItem
classes.description: Model for path item object, representing API endpoints.

classes.name: APIKey
classes.description: Model for API key security scheme.

classes.name: HTTPBearer
classes.description: Model for Bearer token HTTP security scheme.

classes.name: OpenIdConnect
classes.description: Model for OpenID Connect security scheme.

classes.name: SecurityScheme
classes.description: Union type for all security schemes.

methods.name: Schema.model_rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the Pydantic model schema for Schema class.

methods.name: Operation.model_rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the Pydantic model schema for Operation class.

methods.name: Encoding.model_rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the Pydantic model schema for Encoding class.
